name: I am the Gardener Hero, summoned from another world!
source:
Using magic, you've been summoned to a new world!

You're a hero who must save the kingdom from a demon lord!

But it turns out it's not that simple, because you don't have any heroic abilities!

Except for one thing...

You're a gardener...

But you can't grow fruits and vegetables...

But..., but you can bring heads to life and grow them in a flowerpot!

Pretty cool, right???
translation:
在魔法的召唤下，你来到了一个全新的世界！

你是肩负着从魔王手中拯救王国重任的勇者！

然而事情并没有那么简单，因为你压根没有任何勇者该有的技能！

唯独除了一件事……

你是个园丁……

但你种不出水果，也种不出蔬菜……

可是……可是你能赋予头颅生命，把它们栽在花盆里养大！

是不是超酷的？？？
